question: Who was the singer of the famous song 'Mere Desh Ki Dharti Sona Ugle' from the film 'Upkar' (1967)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahendra Kapoor**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahendra Kapoor** was the singer of the famous song 'Mere Desh Ki Dharti Sona Ugle' from the film 'Upkar' (1967).
 
• The song is one of the most iconic patriotic songs in Indian cinema.
 
• Mahendra Kapoor's powerful voice and rendition of the song played a significant role in its enduring popularity.
 
• 'Upkar' was a film directed by Manoj Kumar, who is known for his patriotic themes in cinema.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahendra Kapoor** was a prominent playback singer in Bollywood, known for his versatile singing style.
 
• He won several awards throughout his career, including the National Film Award for Best Male Playback Singer.
 
• Mahendra Kapoor's contributions to Indian music have left a lasting legacy, and he is remembered for his melodious voice and memorable songs.
 
• 'Mere Desh Ki Dharti' is celebrated on various national occasions and remains a symbol of patriotism in India.
